title: Equal Employment Opportunity Policy and Program - signed 2026-08-26
summary: Currentest ingested EEO policy statement, signed 2026-08-26. It covers nondiscrimination across employment actions, anti-retaliation, reasonable accommodation, EEO complaint/program responsibilities, and assigns day-to-day EEO management/complaint investigation authority.

claims.claim: RTEC states that employment opportunities and actions are to be administered without unlawful exclusion based on protected classes listed in the policy.
The policy prohibits retaliation against people who complain of discrimination, participate in discrimination proceedings, or otherwise engage in protected activity.
RTEC commits to reasonable accommodations for disability or religious practice/observance absent undue hardship.

The Executive Director retains overall responsibility/accountability for EEO compliance while the appointed EEO Officer handles day-to-day program management, monitoring and complaint investigation and reports directly to the Executive Director.
Executives, management and supervisors share responsibility for implementing and monitoring the EEO program in their areas, with performance evaluated on implementation.

outputs: EEO program available for inspection upon request
exceptions: Reasonable accommodation obligation is stated as subject to undue hardship.
controls: Direct reporting relationship for EEO Officer
unresolved_questions: What separate current EEO Program document sets the detailed goals, timetables, complaint process and reporting requirements?
What current forms/logs are used to receive and investigate EEO complaints?
automation_candidates: EEO complaint intake and case-status workflow with restricted access and retention controls.
Version tracking for annual/periodic EEO statement signatures and officer assignments.
